title: Contested Shot Pump Fake
description: Shooters work against a hand in their face, using a pump fake to get a defender airborne before rising for a clean, uncontested shot.

content.objective: Use a believable pump fake to draw a defender off their feet before shooting clean.
content.setup: A shooter catches the ball as a defender closes out with a hand up.
instructions: On the catch, sell a shot fake with the ball and eyes, holding the base as if shooting.
If the defender jumps, rise and shoot once they're in the air.
If the defender holds their ground, pass or attack off the dribble instead.
coachingPoints: Keep the fake low and short — a big fake telegraphs and wastes time.
Only shoot once the defender has actually left their feet.
Have a second option ready if the fake doesn't draw a jump.
commonMistakes: Shooting into a defender who never left the ground.
Faking so big that there's no time left to actually shoot.
Dropping the follow-through early instead of holding it.
content.safety: The defender contests with verticality, not by lunging into the shooter.
